business_summary: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. provides midstream energy services to producers and consumers of natural gas, natural gas liquids (NGLs), crude oil, petrochemicals, and refined products. It operates in four segments: NGL Pipelines & Services; Crude Oil Pipelines & Services; Natural Gas Pipelines & Services; and Petrochemical & Refined Products Services. The NGL Pipelines & Services segment offers natural gas processing and related NGL marketing activities. This segment operates natural gas processing facilities located in Colorado, Louisiana, Mississippi, New Mexico, Texas, and Wyoming; NGL pipelines; NGL fractionation facilities; NGL and related product storage facilities; and NGL marine terminals. The Crude Oil Pipelines & Services segment operates crude oil pipelines; and crude oil storage and marine terminals, which include a fleet of approximately 200 tractor-trailer tank trucks that are used to transport crude oil. It also engages in crude oil marketing activities. The Natural Gas Pipelines & Services segment operates natural gas pipeline systems to gather, treat, and transport natural gas. It leases underground salt dome natural gas storage facilities in Napoleonville, Louisiana; owns an underground salt dome storage cavern in Wharton County, Texas; and transports, stores, and markets natural gas. The Petrochemical & Refined Products Services segment operates propylene fractionation facilities, including propylene fractionation units and propane dehydrogenation facilities, and related marketing activities; butane isomerization complex and related deisobutanizer operations; and octane enhancement, isobutane dehydrogenation, and high purity isobutylene production facilities. It also operates refined products pipelines and terminals; and ethylene export terminals; and provides refined products marketing and marine transportation services. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
business_summary_ko: Enterprise Products Partners L.P.는 천연가스, 천연가스액체(NGL), 원유, 석유화학 제품 및 정제 제품의 생산자와 소비자에게 미드스트림 에너지 서비스를 제공합니다. NGL 파이프라인 및 서비스; 원유 파이프라인 및 서비스; 천연가스 파이프라인 및 서비스; 석유화학 및 정유제품 서비스. NGL 파이프라인 및 서비스 부문은 천연가스 처리 및 관련 NGL 마케팅 활동을 제공합니다. 이 부문은 콜로라도, 루이지애나, 미시시피, 뉴멕시코, 텍사스, 와이오밍에 위치한 천연가스 처리 시설을 운영합니다. NGL 파이프라인; NGL 분류 시설; NGL 및 관련 제품 보관 시설 및 NGL 해양 터미널. 원유 파이프라인 및 서비스 부문은 원유 파이프라인을 운영합니다. 원유 운송에 사용되는 약 200대의 트랙터-트레일러 탱크 트럭을 포함하는 원유 저장 및 해양 터미널. 또한 원유 마케팅 활동에도 참여하고 있습니다. 천연가스 파이프라인 및 서비스 부문은 천연가스 파이프라인 시스템을 운영하여 천연가스를 수집, 처리 및 운송합니다. 루 나폴레옹빌의 지하 소금돔 천연가스 저장 시설을 임대합니다.
